displayName: Local News API: Search Articles, Sources, Meeting Transcripts & Events
description: Local news API: articles on local government, city council, elections, courts, public safety, schools and health, their sources (meeting transcripts, people quoted, video clips) and a local events and public hearing calendar. Read-only. Communities News platform; live for Alaska News.
